apiKeyHashed.preheader: Your keys keep working. Nothing to do unless you need to re-copy a key.
apiKeyHashed.heading: API key security update
apiKeyHashed.intro: We have upgraded how Dynopay stores your API keys. Keys are now kept as a one-way hash — the same model used by Stripe and Coinbase — so even a copy of our database could never reveal your key.
apiKeyHashed.whatValue: Keys are shown once, at creation or rotation, and can no longer be revealed from the dashboard.
apiKeyHashed.keysValue: Keep working exactly as before. No change is needed in your integration.
apiKeyHashed.actionValue: None — unless you have not saved your key anywhere. In that case, rotate it once from Developer › API keys.
apiKeyHashed.rotate: To rotate: open Developer › API keys, press Regenerate, copy the new key immediately and update your integration. The old key stops working the moment you regenerate.
apiKeyHashed.outro: Questions? Reply to this email — we are happy to help.

twoFaEnabled.subject: 2FA is on for your account
twoFaEnabled.heading: Two-factor authentication enabled
twoFaEnabled.intro: Two-factor authentication (2FA) is now protecting your Dynopay account. From now on you'll need a code from your authenticator app each time you sign in.
twoFaEnabled.tip: Keep your backup codes somewhere safe — they're the only way in if you lose access to your authenticator app.
twoFaEnabled.preheader: Your account now requires an authenticator code to sign in.

twoFaDisabled.subject: 2FA was turned off — was that you?
twoFaDisabled.heading: Two-factor authentication disabled
twoFaDisabled.intro: Two-factor authentication (2FA) was just turned off on your Dynopay account. Your password alone now unlocks your account.
twoFaDisabled.preheader: 2FA was turned off on your account — was that you?

backupCodes.subject: Your 2FA backup codes were replaced
backupCodes.heading: Backup codes regenerated
backupCodes.intro: A new set of two-factor backup codes was generated for your Dynopay account. Your previous backup codes no longer work.
backupCodes.tip: Store the new codes somewhere safe and never share them with anyone.
backupCodes.preheader: Your old backup codes no longer work.

phoneAdded.subject: Phone number added to your account
phoneAdded.heading: Phone number added
phoneAdded.intro: A phone number was just added to your Dynopay account. You can now sign in and receive verification codes by SMS.
phoneAdded.preheader: You can now receive verification codes by SMS.

phoneChanged.subject: Phone number updated on your account
phoneChanged.heading: Phone number updated
phoneChanged.intro: The phone number on your Dynopay account was just changed. Verification codes and security alerts will now go to the new number.
phoneChanged.preheader: Codes and alerts now go to your new number.

phoneRemoved.subject: Phone number removed from your account
phoneRemoved.heading: Phone number removed
phoneRemoved.intro: The phone number was just removed from your Dynopay account. SMS sign-in is no longer available until you add a new number.
phoneRemoved.preheader: SMS sign-in is no longer available on your account.

accountDeleted.subject: Your Dynopay account has been deleted
accountDeleted.heading: Account deleted
accountDeleted.intro: As requested, your Dynopay account and all of its data — brands, payment links, API keys, payout wallets and settings — have been permanently deleted.
accountDeleted.outro: If you ever want to accept crypto again, you're welcome back any time.
accountDeleted.notice: Didn't request this? Contact our support team immediately.
accountDeleted.preheader: Your account and its data were permanently removed.

accountSuspended.subject: Your Dynopay account has been suspended
accountSuspended.heading: Account suspended
accountSuspended.intro: Your Dynopay account has been temporarily suspended. You won't be able to sign in or process payments while it's suspended.
accountSuspended.outro: If you believe this is a mistake, or you'd like to resolve it, reply to this email or contact our support team.
accountSuspended.preheader: Sign-in and payments are paused on your account.

accountBanned.subject: Your Dynopay account has been closed
accountBanned.heading: Account closed
accountBanned.intro: Your Dynopay account has been permanently closed for violating our terms of service. Sign-in and payment processing are no longer available.
accountBanned.outro: If you believe this decision is wrong, contact our support team and we'll review it.
accountBanned.preheader: Your account was closed for a terms-of-service violation.

accountReactivated.subject: Your Dynopay account is active again
accountReactivated.heading: Welcome back — your account is active
accountReactivated.intro: Good news: your Dynopay account has been reactivated. You can sign in and accept payments as usual.
accountReactivated.preheader: You can sign in and accept payments again.

security.didntDoThis: Didn't do this? Someone else may have access to your account. Change your password right away and contact our support team.

stepUp.subject: Your Dynopay verification code
stepUp.heading: Verify it's you
stepUp.intro: Use this code to confirm a sensitive change on your Dynopay account: {{action}}.
stepUp.expiry: This code expires in 5 minutes and unlocks the action for 10 minutes.
stepUp.ignore: If you didn't request this, do NOT share the code — someone may be trying to change your account. Your settings stay unchanged until a code is entered.
stepUp.preheader: One-time code for a sensitive account change · Dynopay will never ask for this code.

twoFaReset.subject: Reset your two-step verification
twoFaReset.preheader: Confirm to remove your authenticator app and switch to email codes.
twoFaReset.heading: Reset two-step verification?
twoFaReset.intro: Someone (hopefully you) asked to reset the authenticator app on your account after entering the correct password. Click below to confirm. The link expires in 30 minutes and works once.
twoFaReset.consequences: Confirming will sign you out of every device, forget all trusted browsers, switch your second step to email codes and lock payout-wallet changes for 24 hours as a safety measure.
twoFaReset.ignore: If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email — nothing changes. Consider changing your password if you don't recognise this activity.

twoFaResetDone.subject: Your two-step verification was reset
twoFaResetDone.preheader: Authenticator removed, sessions signed out, wallet changes locked for 24 hours.
twoFaResetDone.heading: Two-step verification reset
twoFaResetDone.intro: Your authenticator app was removed and email codes are now your second step at sign-in. All sessions and trusted devices were signed out.
twoFaResetDone.freeze: Payout-wallet changes are locked until {{until}}. Our team has been notified and can lift the lock sooner if you contact support.

buyerPaymentExpired.whatNext: What happens next: {{companyName}} has been notified and can see exactly what arrived. Please contact them directly to settle the difference or arrange a refund of the partial amount.

paymentLinkReminder.urgencyReminder2Expiring: Don't forget! You have {{timeRemaining}} remaining to complete this payment.

paymentLinkReminder.urgencyFinal: This is a final reminder about your pending payment. Please complete it soon or contact {{companyName}} if you have questions.

paymentSettled.preheader: Net {{net}} {{asset}} forwarded to your wallet — full breakdown inside.
paymentSettled.intro: {{companyName}} received a payment and it has settled. Here is exactly where the money went.
paymentSettled.introForwarding: {{companyName}} received a payment and it has settled. The net amount is being forwarded to your payout wallet now.
